import json
from pathlib import Path
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

model = str(Path.home() / '.cache/mmb_models/Qwen3.5-4B-MLX-4bit')
revision = '32f3e8ecf65426fc3306969496342d504bfa13f3'
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model, revision=revision)
r = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'audit full supervised answer window without loading model weights', 'data': 'train/data'}, revision),
     'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'source_sha256': file_sha256(__file__), 'splits': {}}
for split in ('train', 'valid'):
    path = Path('train/data') / (split + '.jsonl')
    widths = []
    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
        messages = json.loads(line)['messages']
        prefix = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages[:-1], add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False, return_dict=False)
        target = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages, enable_thinking=False, return_dict=False)
        assert target[:len(prefix)] == prefix
        widths.append(len(target) - len(prefix))
    r['splits'][split] = {'rows': len(widths), 'minimum_answer_tokens': min(widths), 'maximum_answer_tokens': max(widths), 'input_sha256': file_sha256(path)}
r['window_check'] = {'configured_width': 128, 'maximum_required_width_under_upstream_mask': max(s['maximum_answer_tokens'] + 1 for s in r['splits'].values()), 'note': 'mlx-lm 0.32.2 uses an inclusive end boundary and padded batches: its default objective includes one boundary padding target. The existing full-loss/gradient parity tests intentionally preserve this upstream convention; no active-run objective or hyperparameter changes.'}
r['upstream_source_sha256'] = {str(p): file_sha256(p) for p in Path('.venv/lib').glob('python*/site-packages/mlx_lm/tuner/*.py') if p.name in ('trainer.py', 'datasets.py')}
Path('results/training/qwen35_answer_width.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(r['splits']))
